easyPrerequisites:
Malcolm doesn't have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion and Hawkeye's Bow are both attached to Malcolm.
description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Malcolm.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, causing Malcolm to deal 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Malcolm.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
